bus_stop_rate — DRIVE traffic op

• 数据种类:any → any

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.bus_stop_rate(x, *, bus_rear: 'float', bus_front: 'float', base: 'float', peak: 'float', spread: 'float')(要直接调用实现,import drivetraffic; drivetraffic.bus_stop_rate(x, *, bus_rear: 'float', bus_front: 'float', base: 'float', peak: 'float', spread: 'float');从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("bus_stop_rate"))

用法

在停靠公交车前后较高的出现率 λ(x) = base + peak [exp(−½((x − rear)/spread)²) + exp(−½((x − front)/spread)²)] [次/m]。表示行人从公交车的阴影(前端之前)和后方走出的模式示例(值为调用方的假定)。上限为 base + 2·peak。
